CLOUD FIXER seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, topic r10-ci-ratchet-window, at head 5d433771aa88bbfd49b8868a9b53ea1241ab85a3. Never send push notifications.

Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 5d433771aa88bbfd49b8868a9b53ea1241ab85a3 for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-ci-ratchet-window, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-ci-ratchet-window <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-ci-ratchet-window; that second push is the return signal. Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix, topic r10-ci-ratchet-window (size S fly-in R10-FLY-CI-RATCHET-WINDOW, to be registered on the roster by the orchestrator after the roster PR merges: do not edit the roster). Defect: the ci-ratchet job step "Gather this run's and the recent window's metrics" in .github/workflows/tests.yml (about lines 2883-2920 at origin/main) runs `gh api "repos/<repo>/actions/artifacts?per_page=100" --jq '...' > window.json || true`. The repo now holds ~18,000 artifacts and GitHub answers HTTP 500 with an empty body on most unfiltered calls of that endpoint; `|| true` swallows the failure, window.json is empty, and the Python json.load raises JSONDecodeError. Every main push run since 2026-10-21 11:34Z (run 39585970262 onward, 11 in a row) is red on ci-ratchet; last green job 39585211229 at 11:27Z. ci-ratchet is not a required context (ruleset 23698884), but it keeps main push runs red and makes the tick report a false main-red. Evidence (re-derive it yourself with gh api, at most a few calls): the same endpoint with ?per_page=5 or &name=ci-metrics-<lane> returns 200. Fix (architecturally sound, smallest): query each lane by name (?name=ci-metrics-$lane&per_page=100) in a loop and merge the results, keep the null-safe `.workflow_run.id // .run_id` selection, and remove `|| true` (or retry with a bounded backoff, then fail LOUDLY naming the HTTP status) so an empty window.json can never reach the Python step. Failing test first: tests/ci_ratchet.py or the nearest harness that parses this step; a mutation proof (restore `|| true` / the unfiltered query and the test fails); a null control; re-derive the lane names from the workflow's own upload-artifact names, never hardcode. Follow fixer.md in full, including the structural ratchet and closures rules. This is a workflow-file change: say in the body whether the file is code-owned. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1. Push code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-ci-ratchet-window and the body with body_push.sh r10-ci-ratchet-window. ## Red checks must answer nightly-status (grades main) and say that ci-ratchet on main is the defect being fixed.
